## v0.5.1
Bug fixes and internal restructuring, no breaking changes.

- Fixed: version 0.5.0 could not be imported on Python 3.11 (`grouping_types.py` used the `type` statement, which needs Python 3.12), although 3.11 is declared as supported
- Fixed: the `dynamic_modal_analysis` extra now includes `jinja2`, which pandas needs for the styled tables
- Fixed in `Database`/`DatabaseDict`: string attributes such as `loc_name` could not be set with `set_pf_obj_attribute_values`, result-variable patterns were case-insensitive on Windows (`"m_u*"` also matched `"m_U"`), and `keys_to_obj_attr_str`, `get_obj_attribute_strings` and `set_values_of_dict` did not work
- `dynamic_modal_analysis`, `modelica` and `subsystems` are now packages of focused submodules. All names are still importable from `powfacpy.applications.<name>`
- New composed helpers `Folder.objects` (copy, move, delete) and `Folder.attributes` (get, set). The existing `Folder`/`ActiveProject` methods keep their signatures and forward to them; none are deprecated
- Continuous integration (GitHub Actions): ruff, unit tests on Python 3.11-3.13 and a package build. The test suite now skips everything that needs *PowerFactory* when it is not installed
- Documentation: API stability of the modules, how to regenerate the generated files, and what the automatic checks do

## v0.5.0
Everything below summarizes what changed since v0.4.3 (releases in between were not individually documented here).

- New `dynamic_modal_analysis` application module (`ModalAnalysis`): eigenvalues, damping ratios, natural/damped frequencies and participation factors from PowerFactory's modal analysis command (`ComMod`), with filtering, plotting, eigenvalue tracking across a parameter sweep, and eigenvalue sensitivity (both the classical eigenvector-weighted formula and finite-difference) - see the new [tutorial](../tutorials/dynamic_modal_analysis.qmd)
- `parameter_studies` (`pf_parameter`, `apply_gradient`) is now built on the new, backend-agnostic [`parstudy`](https://github.com/FraunhIEE-UniKassel-PowSysStability/parstudy) package rather than a bespoke sweep loop - see the updated [tutorial](../tutorials/parameter_studies.qmd)
- New `attribute_metadata` module: resolve PowerFactory's own GUI enum labels via the localisation database, so `set_attr(..., resolve_enum_names=True)` can set an integer-enum attribute by its GUI name (e.g. `i_mot="Motor"`) instead of a raw, undocumented integer
- New `digsilent_library` module and `template_models` package: GUI-name navigation of PowerFactory's template library, and per-template interfaces (e.g. grid-forming converters)
- `subsystems`: added secondary (power-frequency) control support
- Extended unit-dispatch API: `GroupingBase.get_internal_pv/wind/bess/sg` (and `.pv`/`.wind`/`.bess`/`.sg` accessors), `SinglePortBase.set_power_dispatch`, new `StaticGenerator`/`PVSystem` interface classes
- Internal refactor of `Folder`/`ActiveProject` (no breaking changes to existing methods): cohesive method groups extracted into composed helpers reachable as `ActiveProject.monitored_variables`, `.study_cases`, `.projects` and `Folder.paths`; `PFStringManipulation` became plain module functions in `base/string_manipulation.py` (the old class is kept as a deprecated shim)
- Removed dead code (`pf_elm_objects.py`, the unused `PFTranslator` class) and the unused `icecream` dependency
- `dependencies` split into a lean core plus optional extras - `pandapower`, `comtrade`, `docs`, `parstudy`, `dynamic_modal_analysis`, `tutorials`, `dev`, `all` - see the [installation section](../index.qmd#installation)
- Various bug fixes found while substantially raising test coverage (now largely PowerFactory-license-free for the pure-Python parts, `pytest -m unit`), including a `SynchronousMachine.q` property that returned the wrong value and a `set_attr_resettable` that could restore the wrong original value
- Declares `requires-python >= 3.11` and PyPI classifiers

## v0.3.0
- Structural changes: 
  - In this version, the structure of *powfacpy* has changed fundamentally
  - Please have a look at [Structure of *powfacpy*](../docs/structure_of_powfacpy.qmd) to understand the new structure and why the restructuring was necessary
  - Instead of PFBaseInterface the class `ActiveProject` from *base/active_project* should be used
  - Interfaces for plotting, case study, etc. are now found under *applications/*.
  - All former interface classes can still be used, but their files are located in a folder called *deprecated* and you will get  deprecation warnings
- There should be few breaking changes. Some of the known are:
  - The labels of the result export to pandas have changed (see the [tutorial](../tutorials/dynamic_simulation_and_plotting.qmd))
  - The name of the method `export_results_of_study_cases` of the class `PFStudyCases` has changed to `export_results_of_study_cases_to_csv`
- *black* formatter was introduced as the standard formatter for python code
- The format of the website was changed from *sphinx* to *quarto*
- Functionality:
  - Interface for network topology was added
  - Interfaces to several single *PowerFactory* classes was added (see *src/powfacpy/pf_classes/*)
